data.one_liner: Chess piece vector widgets for Flutter based on Wikimedia Commons SVGs.
data.what_it_does: Provides custom widgets representing chess pieces as vectors. Allows you to customize the size, stroke, and fill color of each piece.
use_when: Building a chess game UI in Flutter
You need scalable vector chess pieces with color customization
avoid_when: You need general SVG rendering support not limited to chess pieces
You need built-in chess logic or board state management
strengths: Customizable size, stroke, and fill color for each piece
Based on standard Wikimedia Commons SVG definitions
weaknesses: Not documented for complex chess board interactions
